items.title: Extinguish on Sight: Firestorm
items.summary: Site Status: Fully engulfed in flames. Clearance: Open Raid, solo only. Threats: Burning Devourers, Scorches, fire anomalies, and hostile rival Operatives. Objective: Track the anomalous signals, locate the sources of ignition, and extract alive. Equipment: Got a fire extinguisher? Equip it in a weapon slot.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.205
items.summary: In this update, markers made on the map, and shown on the compass, now show distance and elevation more clearly. The “Repair All” inventory button now also repairs armor being carried as spares, and DualSense touchpad functionality hs been improved.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.201
items.summary: Fixed muzzle flash hiders as they now once again help conceal your position when firing. Resolved several gameplay bugs in raids and made interface improvements. Controls have been further refined and performance on consoles has been improved.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.199
items.summary: Interface Gear presets now equip correctly when pressing the "Purchase and Equip" button. Gear presets are now purchased without camouflages: if the preset included a camouflage on a weapon, it won't be purchased or applied. You can apply one separately afterwards as normal.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.196
items.summary: Controls The weapon tactical flashlight and laser sight can once again be toggled separately. By default, both options are bound to the same control (“L” on keyboard), but you can assign a different binding to either of them in the controls settings.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.195
items.summary: Managing gear has become less of a hassle, magazines no longer can drop on reload, visual recoil when using scopes has been adjusted, and improved item swapping when changing backpacks and safe containers at the Shelter.

items.title: Signal Lost
items.summary: URGENT! We've lost contact with one of our Operatives, and a sudden anomaly has wiped the data on which raid they deployed to. But, their camera transmitted one final frame, and the zone is about to collapse with them still inside.

items.title: Server update
items.summary: Extended the search time of the auto-fill squad feature, it should find players twice as often now.

items.title: Active Matter: Activity Report
items.summary: How have we already improved the game? Here are just a few examples of what we’ve fixed in recent days and weeks. Fewer motion sickness-inducing effects reduce camera bobbing while moving directly in the game’s settings menu.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.182
items.summary: Gameplay and Balance Rare "Guts" and "Ghost" Body Sleeves have been reworked: they are now "epic" Body Sleeves with the same characteristics as the "Knight" and "Paladin" Body Sleeves. In Isolated (PvE) Raids, Invisibles and Hellhounds no longer suddenly spawn near players who remain in one area for a long time.

items.title: A Beginner Operative’s Guide
items.summary: The Agency HQ has prepared an introductory briefing for operatives being deployed to explore the Multiverse. Reviewing the material is recommended before proceeding. [img src=" src=" src=" src=" src=" src=" src=" src="

items.title: Update 0.4.0.173
items.summary: Gameplay and Balance Updated Molotov Cocktails and Incendiary Grenades to immediately ignite enemies splashed with the flammable mixture. Previously, 1–2 seconds in the flame were required to catch fire. Updated Devourers to take damage from flamethrowers and areas of fire.

items.title: Week 3 Rewards For Watching Active Matter Streams!
items.summary: NOTE: To receive Twitch Drops for Active Matter, you must first own an edition of the game. If you purchased or received the game on Steam, you need to launch it at least once first. Then, sign in with Steam on this page and select Active Matter from the list of games that appears, if prompted.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.165
items.summary: Distorted that teleport in front of a fleeing player now appear farther away, giving you more time to react. Agitated Distorted animate more visibly, making it easier to see whether their sleep is restless, and that they could wake up at any moment.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.164
items.summary: When firing in full-auto, the sight now tracks weapon recoil accurately and correctly again. Previously, a bug could cause the sight position to drift from the actual point of impact. Recoil itself is unchanged.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.163
items.summary: Enemies Reduced the pursuit range of Seeds: they now give up the chase sooner. Fixed an issue where Hellhounds could spawn on rooftops. Distorted that are already chasing a fleeing target will now occasionally teleport ahead of it.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.156
items.summary: Creating Personal Timelines Placed all equipped gear to a temporary stash after creating a new Personal Timeline; equipped chronogenes, as before, are discarded.

items.title: Earn More Rewards For Watching Active Matter Streams!
items.summary: We’re continuing to celebrate the release of Active Matter on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, so tune in to more Active Matter live streams on Twitch from September 25th (15:00 UTC) to October 2nd (15:00 UTC) and earn fresh rewards for your loadout!

items.title: Update "The Fundamental Protocol"
items.summary: Rewards in this Protocol can be redeemed with Merits at any time, whether or not you’re currently participating in a Harmonization Cycle! Rewards include consumables, unique decorations, Credits, and Monolith Tokens — everything you need to accelerate your push toward establishing your new Personal Timeline.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.137
items.summary: Raids and Profile Restored the unlocking of a Devourer’s journal entry in the Notes upon defeating one. Harmonization Fixed incorrect dog tag issuance when purchasing during Harmonization Cycle 2.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.135
items.summary: Improved the ability to reconnect to a raid after a connection loss. Fixed a bug where items in containers (e.g., in chests and bags) occupied space but were not displayed. Fixed a rare server freeze. Fixed a bug where some players did not appear in the Playstation® 5 friends list.

items.title: Scheduled Maintenance on Active Matter Servers
items.summary: Hello, Operatives! On September 22nd, from 07:00 UTC to approximately 07:30 UTC, we will be performing scheduled maintenance on the Active Matter servers. The Agency apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciates your patience during the calibration of portals to the Multiverse.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.132
items.summary: Gameplay and Balance Increased the number of the stronger Distorted variants in areas marked with a threat of Distorted. Updated level 2-5 rewards to no longer require a specific edition; all players now receive them. Added loot to Ural truck cargo. Disabled the use of items while in monster form.

items.title: The Agency Is Recruiting Content Creators!
items.summary: We’ve completely reworked our Content Partnership Program for video makers, streamers, and other creators. Participants can now receive regular in-game bonuses plus support to grow their channels. Constant supply: regular distribution of in-game resources, so you’re always equipped both in the raid and on camera.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.122
items.summary: By order of the Agency, an experimental Body Sleeve appearance-correction mode has been activated. Spatial distortions may occur; further adjustments are planned in subsequent updates. Character Customization Added Body Sleeve customization (BETA), available on the Sleeve selection screen.

items.title: Rewards for Watching Active Matter Streams All Week!
items.summary: To celebrate the launch of Active Matter on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, tune in to Active Matter live streams on Twitch from September 18th (15:00 UTC) to September 25th (15:00 UTC) and earn new rewards for your loadout! Drops run for a full three weeks; we’ll reveal the rewards for Weeks 2 and 3 soon!

items.title: Update 0.4.0.115
items.summary: Improved performance, reworked several animations, fixed multiple bugs, and delivered important updates to the user interface and sound. Gameplay and Balance Fixed an issue that displayed an incorrect magazine round count when spawning into a raid. Fixed an animation glitch that could interrupt reloads.

items.title: Active Matter Is Now Available On PC
items.summary: Operatives, the door to the Multiverse is open! Active Matter is out now on Steam! If you purchased the early version from the Gaijin Store, you can get the Steam edition at no extra cost until November 23rd. New Harmonization Cycle With the release, the next Harmonization Cycle begins, featuring new rewards.
